req.title: Handle CORS pre-flight OPTIONS
req.statement: The system shall respond to OPTIONS requests with appropriate Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that OPTIONS requests to any endpoint return HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers headers. httpbin uses Flask-CORS or manual CORS handling. We test: (1) positive — OPTIONS to a known endpoint returns 200 with both CORS headers present and non-empty; (2) negative — OPTIONS to a non-existent path should still return a CORS-aware response (not 500); (3) boundary — OPTIONS with an Origin header triggers the full pre-flight response including Access-Control-Allow-Origin; (4) decision-table — OPTIONS without Origin still returns Allow-Methods; (5) exact-value — Access-Control-Allow-Methods contains expected HTTP verbs. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact header names (case-insensitive), and non-empty header values rather than mere existence.

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_allow_methods
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
CORS support is enabled in the app
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_allow_methods():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods')
    assert allow_methods is not None, 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods header missing'
    assert len(allow_methods.strip()) > 0, 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods is empty'

test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_allow_methods()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_not_500_on_unknown_path
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to a non-existent path /nonexistent-endpoint-xyz
expected: Response status code is in range 200-499 (client or success, not server error)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: error pathway — HTTP 5xx on server error must not occur for OPTIONS
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_not_500_on_unknown_path():
    r = client.options(
        '/nonexistent-endpoint-xyz',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code != 500, f'Got unexpected 500 server error'
    assert r.status_code != 503, f'Got unexpected 503 server error'
    assert r.status_code < 500, f'Got server error {r.status_code}, expected < 500'

test_cors_preflight_options_not_500_on_unknown_path()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get WITHOUT an Origin header (boundary: no CORS trigger)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: boundary — OPTIONS without Origin header should still yield 2xx
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx():
    r = client.options('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 400, 'Got 400 unexpectedly'
    assert r.status_code != 405, 'Got 405 Method Not Allowed unexpectedly'

test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_allow_methods_contains_common_verbs
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
CORS support is enabled in the app
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin header
Inspect Access-Control-Allow-Methods for expected HTTP verbs
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Access-Control-Allow-Methods must list appropriate methods
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_allow_methods_contains_common_verbs():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert 'GET' in allow_methods.upper(), f'GET not in Allow-Methods: {allow_methods}'
    assert 'POST' in allow_methods.upper(), f'POST not in Allow-Methods: {allow_methods}'

test_cors_preflight_allow_methods_contains_common_verbs()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_on_post_endpoint
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
CORS support is enabled in the app
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /post (POST-only endpoint) with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: POST
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: OPTIONS /* covers POST-only endpoints as boundary case
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_on_post_endpoint():
    r = client.options(
        '/post',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://test.example.org',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'POST',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods') is not None, \
        'Missing Access-Control-Allow-Methods'
    assert r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers') is not None, \
        'Missing Access-Control-Allow-Headers'

test_cors_preflight_options_on_post_endpoint()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_status_not_4xx_client_error
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /delete with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: DELETE
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error must not occur for valid OPTIONS pre-flight
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_status_not_4xx_client_error():
    r = client.options(
        '/delete',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'DELETE'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 400, 'Got 400 Bad Request unexpectedly'
    assert r.status_code != 405, 'Got 405 Method Not Allowed unexpectedly'
    assert r.status_code != 403, 'Got 403 Forbidden unexpectedly'

test_cors_preflight_options_status_not_4xx_client_error()
